verses.pali: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo rūpassa uppādāya, sopi anicco.
verses.english: The cause and reason that gives rise to form is also impermanent.

verses.pali: Aniccasambhūtaṁ, bhikkhave, rūpaṁ kuto niccaṁ bhavissati.
verses.english: Since form is produced by what is impermanent, how could it be permanent?

verses.pali: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo vedanāya uppādāya, sopi anicco.
Aniccasambhūtā, bhikkhave, vedanā kuto niccā bhavissati.
Yopi hetu yopi paccayo saṅkhārānaṁ uppādāya, sopi anicco.
Aniccasambhūtā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā kuto niccā bhavissanti.
Yopi hetu yopi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya, sopi anicco.
verses.english: The cause and reason that gives rise to consciousness is also impermanent.

verses.pali: Aniccasambhūtaṁ, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṁ kuto niccaṁ bhavissati.
verses.english: Since consciousness is produced by what is impermanent, how could it be permanent?
They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”
